prompt: Which correctly loops background music from a classpath WAV file?
choices: try { AudioInputStream ais = AudioSystem.getAudioInputStream(getClass().getResource("/music.wav")); Clip clip = AudioSystem.getClip(); clip.open(ais); clip.loop(Clip.LOOP_CONTINUOUSLY); } catch (Exception e) { e.printStackTrace(); }
MediaPlayer player = new MediaPlayer("/music.wav"); player.setLoop(true); player.play();
explanation: AudioSystem.getAudioInputStream(URL) loads from classpath resource. clip.open(ais) prepares it; clip.loop(LOOP_CONTINUOUSLY) starts looping. Option A blocks a thread and creates many resources. Options C and D use APIs that don't exist in standard Java SE.
